objective: maximize modelled population within 100 km road+assumed connector distance
candidate_set: 26 existing GeoNames urban nodes, not proposed new cities
removal_method: one independent uniform draw per selected road feature; fixed sample for each graph scenario; not calibrated OSM incompleteness
coordinate_method: fixed 250 m displacement with independent random azimuth per hub; stress test not positional error distribution
limits: scenario ranges are not confidence intervals
alternative population masks and products are modelled
equal-objective site sets may be nonunique; reported identities are one optimum
no travel speeds because no travel-time claims
